title: Photo Printing
tagline: From digital moment to physical keepsake.
shortDescription: Turns captured moments into instant printed souvenirs that visitors can take home on the spot, from classic prints and photo strips to postcards, stickers, and posters.
longDescription: A print station that turns photos from booths, photographers, or visitors' own phones into a physical keepsake within seconds. Visitors scan a code or pick their picture on screen, and it comes out formatted, framed, and branded for the occasion. Output can be a classic print, a photo strip, a postcard, a sticker, or a poster, and frames, overlays, and the station housing itself can be themed to match the event world. It runs as a standalone print point or as the final stop that hands out what other modules captured. BRDGE handles the interaction logic, scene management, and journey, leaderboard, and data links end to end.

highlights.title: Something to Hold On To
highlights.description: A printed photo travels home, ends up on fridges and desks, and gets shown around, keeping the brand in view long after the event. It works for every age group, with no app and no account needed.

highlights.title: Every Format the Moment Needs
highlights.description: Print classic photos, photo strips, postcards, stickers, or posters, and brand each one with the client's logo, campaign line, or event artwork, so the same station fits a gala, a fan zone, or a product launch.

highlights.title: At Home in Any Venue
highlights.description: Set it up at a sponsor booth, an evening event, or a museum exit, as a staffed print desk or a self-service kiosk, so it slots into almost any brief as an easy add-on.

highlights.title: Dress the Station Itself
highlights.description: Upgrade the plain kiosk to a themed housing (a wooden saloon chest, a space station, a racing pit box), add a print-by-hashtag flow, limit prints per visitor, or unlock a print only after a challenge is completed.

highlights.title: Frames for Every Story
highlights.description: Wrap each print in a frame that tells the story: a Wild West wanted poster, a fantasy castle scene, a racing podium, or a seasonal edition, all from the same print logic.

highlights.title: Prints You Can Count
highlights.description: Add a data layer that counts prints per format, peak times, and the share of visitors who took a keepsake home, and pair it with an opt-in step so every print can also capture a lead.

highlights.title: The Last Stop of the Journey
highlights.description: Pair with Memory Catcher to print booth photos on the spot, with Connected Photographer to hand out professional shots, with Visitor Identificator to send each visitor their own picture, or with Journey Recap to round off the visit with a printed summary.
